answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism employing staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to build a subgame-perfect punishment matrix. This enforces a steep capital barrier where slashing penalties guarantee identity multiplication yields a strictly negative expected payoff, like a porous karst eroding under a huge delta of adversarial costs. Consequently, this cryptoeconomic architecture compels rational agents to forsake Sybil attacks, converging on a robust Nash equilibrium as the protocol executes a precise sonnet of deterministic deterrence.
